messages:
ci-bot: [ALERT] nightwatch job failed on staging-run-08: encode_gpt_small P95 latency +18% (baseline 1700ms -> 2006ms). Full stats: https://internal.redwood-ci/reports/nightwatch/1782504321 :rotating_light:
alana: @eng-runtime seeing this alert. can someone grab a quick repro?
sam: i'll spin up the bench locally, pulling latest master. ping me if you want the flamegraph.
tariq: fyi i deployed a small kernel tweak yesterday (commit a1b2c3d). could be the cause. marking for bisect. :thinking_face:
alana: ok @sam can you run a bisect across a1b2c3d..f6e7g8h? use the nightly bench harness: `tools/bench/bisect --range a1b2c3d..f6e7g8h --target encode_gpt_small --metric p95`
sam: on it. ETA ~20m. will post results here.
marta: adding profiler tip — enable KV cache warmup in the harness to match nightwatch: `--warmup-prefixes 50` otherwise p95 is noisy.
sam: ran first pass, looks like regression narrows to a set of commits around a1b2c3d -> c4d5e6f. starting binary search now.
ci-bot: queued job: bisect-1782504321-batch with params `{"range":"a1b2c3d..f6e7g8h","target":"encode_gpt_small"}`.
sam: bisect finished — suspect commit c4d5e6f (introduces new attn kernel). quick diff: `runtime/kernel/attn_opt.cpp` changed loop tiling.
tariq: thanks. i'll run a local perf build with instrumentation and post flamegraphs.
alana: if c4d5e6f is the culprit we need a revert or fallback. can we patch to use previous kernel when sequence len <= 128?
marta: quick workaround: add runtime flag `--force-old-attn` and gate the new kernel behind rollout. can we do that as a hotfix?
tariq: yes, creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 (WIP). includes test and a toggle.
sam: repro numbers with `--force-old-attn` bring P95 back to 1690ms locally.
alana: great. assign to eng-runtime oncall to approve emergency rollout. @marta can you coordinate canary?
marta: will do. I'll schedule canary on us-west-2, 10% traffic for 30m. posting canary plan in #eng-releases after PR merges.
ci-bot: NOTE: nightwatch will retry tomorrow; keep an eye on the job.
alana: thanks everyone. next steps: (1) tariq finishes PR and requests review, (2) marta prepares canary, (3) sam monitors perf dashboards after rollout. leave updates here. :white_check_mark:
